module top_module(
    input clk,
    input areset,
    input train_valid,
    input train_taken,
    output logic [1:0] state
);
    logic [1:0] counter;

    always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            counter <= 2'b01; // Weakly not-taken
        end else if (train_valid) begin
            if (train_taken) begin
                counter <= (counter == 2'b11) ? 2'b11 : counter + 1;
            end else begin
                counter <= (counter == 2'b00) ? 2'b00 : counter - 1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign state = counter;
endmodule

module top_module (
    input clk,
    input [7:0] in,
    input reset,
    output reg done
);

reg [1:0] state;
parameter IDLE = 2'b00, LOOKING_FOR_START = 2'b01, RECEIVING_MESSAGE = 2'b10, DONE = 2'b11;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        done <= 0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (in[3]) begin
                    state <= LOOKING_FOR_START;
                end
            end
            LOOKING_FOR_START: begin
                if (in[3]) begin
                    state <= RECEIVING_MESSAGE;
                end
            end
            RECEIVING_MESSAGE: begin
                if (in[3]) begin
                    state <= DONE;
                end
            end
            DONE: begin
                state <= IDLE;
                done <= 1;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

module top_module (
	input clk,
	input reset,
	input s,
	input w,
	output reg z
);
	
reg [1:0] state;
reg [2:0] w_count;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
	if (reset) begin
		state <= 2'b00; // State A
		w_count <= 3'b000;
		z <= 1'b0;
	end else begin
		case (state)
			2'b00: // State A
				if (s == 1'b1)
					state <= 2'b01; // Move to State B
				else
					state <= 2'b00; // Stay in State A
			2'b01: // State B
				begin
					w_count <= {w_count[1:0], w}; // Shift w into w_count
					if (w_count == 3'b011 || w_count == 3'b101 || w_count == 3'b110) begin
						z <= 1'b1; // Set z to 1 if w was 1 in exactly two of the last three cycles
					end else begin
						z <= 1'b0; // Set z to 0 otherwise
					end
					state <= 2'b00; // Return to State A after processing w_count
				end
		endcase
	end
end

endmodule

module top_module (
	input a,
	input b,
	input c,
	input d,
	output out_sop,
	output out_pos
);

reg out_sop, out_pos;

always_comb begin
	// Sum of Products (SOP) form
	out_sop = (a && b &&!c && d) ||
			 (a &&!b && c && d) ||
			 (!a && b && c && d) ||
			 (!a &&!b &&!c && d) ||
			 (a && b &&!c &&!d) ||
			 (a &&!b &&!c &&!d) ||
			 (!a && b &&!c &&!d) ||
			 (!a &&!b && c &&!d) ||
			 (!a &&!b &&!c &&!d);

	// Product of Sums (POS) form
	out_pos =!(a ||!b ||!c ||!d) ||
			!(a ||!b || c ||!d) ||
			!(a || b ||!c ||!d) ||
			!(a || b || c ||!d) ||
			!(a ||!b ||!c || d) ||
			!(a ||!b || c || d) ||
			!(a || b ||!c || d) ||
			!(a || b || c || d) ||
			!(!a ||!b ||!c ||!d);

end

endmodule

module top_module(
	input clk,
	input reset,
	input [31:0] in,
	output reg [31:0] out);

	reg [31:0] prev_in = 0;
	reg [31:0] capture = 0;

	always @(posedge clk) begin
		if (reset) begin
			capture <= 0;
		end else begin
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) begin
				if (prev_in[i] == 1 && in[i] == 0) begin
					capture[i] <= 1;
				end else begin
					capture[i] <= 0;
				end
			end
		end
	end

	always @(posedge clk) begin
		out <= capture;
	end

	always @(posedge clk) begin
		prev_in <= in;
	end

endmodule

module top_module(
	input clk,
	input shift_ena,
	input count_ena,
	input data,
	output reg [3:0] q);

	always @(posedge clk) begin
		if (shift_ena) begin
			q <= {q[3:1], data};
		end else if (count_ena) begin
			q <= {q[3:1], q[0]};
		end
	end

endmodule
